                              ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


S E C T I O N 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District and RM6 Residential Multi-Unit Disfrict symbols and indications

as shown on Map No. 3-G in the area bounded by


       the alley next north of and parallel to West Augusta Boulevard: a line
       527.86 feet west of and parallel to North Noble Street; West Augusta
       Boulevard; and a line 559.08 feet west of and parallel to North Noble
       Street,


to those of a RM4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.


S E C T I O N 3. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common Address of Property:           1458 West Augusta Boulevard

8.    Has the present owner previously rezoned this property? If Yes, when? 6/22/2016
      (Zoning Ordinance App. No. 18528-Tn

9.    Present Zoning District: RS-3 and RM-6       Proposed Zoning District: RM-4.5

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 3,897.54 square feet

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subiect property is improved with a surface parking area
      that formerly served the four-story building at 1444 W. Augusta.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is proposing to establish the subiect
      property as an independent zoning lot and develop it with a new four-story, three (3) unit
      residential building.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to establish the subiect property as an independent zoning lot and develop it with a new
      four-story, three (3) unit residential building. The proposed building will be masonry in
      construction and measure 47 feet in height. The proposed building will be supported by a
      three (3) car garage located at the rear of the subiect lot.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or afinancialcontribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among Other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

      YES             NO      X
